t: You're on Rupert Street in Soho. It runs parallel to Wardour Street and crosses Shaftesbury Avenue. The street takes its name from Prince Rupert of the Rhine. He was an English-German army officer, admiral and scientist, and he first became prominent as a Royalist cavalry commander in the English Civil War. His father was Frederick the Fifth of the Palatinate, and his mother Elizabeth was the daughter of King James the Sixth and First. So a soldier-prince is remembered in the name of this busy Soho street.
